name: ZooTeens!
what_you_do: Year round teen volunteers run conservation learning stations, work with kids in camps, and build job skills. About two shifts a month.
who_can_apply: Teens currently in high school, ages 14 to 18 when they enter the program. Apply, interview and be picked. Not all applicants are accepted.
pay_detail: Unpaid; $100 annual fee for badge, shirt and materials (financial help available, nobody turned away)
duration: Year round: 30 hours fall, 30 spring, 80 summer
deadline_text: Applications open every year on November 1 and close November 25. They are closed until then.
how_to_apply: Fill out the form in the November window. Interview. Go to the required training.
notes: The page gives the Nov 1 to Nov 25 window as the pattern each year. It does not say the exact 2026 dates are for that year.
